lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid; highest-intensity centroids are clustered posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, transitioning to more widely spaced blobs along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct grid-like nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 8-12 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily concentrated towards the lower-anterior region of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of high-frequency micro-blobs is present in the transitional zone between the head and the first gill slit, contrasting with the larger-scale maculations on the primary flank.
